title: Coherent structures and bifurcation analysis in a toxin-driven plant-herbivore model
summary: This work investigates how toxin-mediated interactions and directed movements shape the emergence of coherent structures in plant-herbivore systems. The analysis focuses on a two-compartment model enclosing a toxin-dependent functional response and a cross-diffusion term that represents ecologically plausible herbivores' movement towards, or away from, vegetation. Two distinct dynamical regimes arise depending on toxicity strength.
